verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS compliance platform like Flagright, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out control. The pack covers only the API, webhooks, the MCP docs server and product features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
